items.q: How long does a typical project take?
items.a: Most projects range from 6 to 16 weeks depending on scope, from discovery through launch.

items.q: Do you work with startups and enterprises?
items.a: Yes — our plans and processes flex from early-stage MVPs to enterprise-grade platforms.

items.q: What technologies do you specialize in?
items.a: Vue, React, Node.js, Python, cloud-native infrastructure and modern mobile stacks.

items.q: Can you support us after launch?
items.a: Absolutely. We offer ongoing maintenance, monitoring and feature development retainers.
Book a discovery call and we'll scope your project within days, not weeks.
